system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Using the secret technique of the Vesper, you are able to transform into a bat-wreathed terror, longer hair, completely red eyes, fur covers your torso, shins and forearms and your ears grow into points. As a bonus action, for the next minute, you enter your Umbral Monarch state. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a Long Rest. If you enter this state again before completing a long rest, you gain 1 rank of exhaustion.
